title: ASL Citizen: A Community-Sourced Dataset for Advancing Isolated Sign Language Recognition
findings: The paper's only mention of religion was in its data cleaning methodology, where 'religious symbols' were identified as personal content and redacted (blurred) from the videos to protect participant privacy.
